_comment: The 20 fixed Ask rsync.ai questions scripts/assistant_eval.py asks (docs/internal/assistant-token-design.md § 8.2). Each only reads, or drafts something the person then reviews; a call to any of write_tools fails the question (api-gateway internal/assistant/eval_questions_test.go keeps that list equal to the gateway's non-draft write tools, and every tool named here one Ask rsync.ai offers). role member runs on RSYNC_EVAL_TOKEN; role admin (the workflow and dashboard drafts, which need a workspace admin) runs on RSYNC_EVAL_ADMIN_TOKEN when it is set. must_call: each item must have a call that ended ok; an item that is a list is met by any one of its tools. draft: the tool whose call must end ok and name what it stored. {name} slots are filled from the workspace by read-only GETs; a question whose slot has nothing to fill is skipped. Change a question and the next report is no longer comparable with a baseline taken before the change.

questions.question: Draft a workflow that runs every Monday at 09:00 UTC on {sql_connection}: one query that counts the rows of any one of its tables, and a message to {channel} with that count.
Draft an alert workflow: each time the pipeline {pipeline} finishes, count the rows of one of the tables on {sql_connection}, and message {channel} only when the count is 0.
Draft a workflow I run by hand: a query on {sql_connection} that lists up to 20 rows of one of its tables, sent to {channel} only when it returns rows.
Propose a change to the workflow {workflow}: keep its conditions as they are, and add a last one that always sends to {channel}.
Draft a dashboard named Eval overview from data I can chart: a bar chart counting rows by one text column, and a scorecard of the row count.
Draft a dashboard with a line chart of row counts over a time column, a table of up to five columns from the same source, and a date range filter on that time column.
On the dashboard {dashboard_with_tiles}, propose renaming its first chart tile to Trend and making it 6 columns wide.
On the dashboard {dashboard_with_tiles}, propose changing its first chart tile's height to 4 rows, keeping its chart as it is.
Why did the pipeline {failed_pipeline} fail?
How has the pipeline {pipeline} been running lately? List its recent runs.
Propose a batch pipeline from {source_connection} to {destination_connection} that runs every day at 03:00 UTC. I will pick the tables when it first runs.
What models do we have, and how did their last runs go?
Pick any one of our models and tell me which data checks it has.
Draft data checks for one of our models: not_null and unique on its key column, and a row count of at least 1.
Which connectors can I use as a CDC source?
Which tables are on the connection {connection}?
Write me a SQL query on {sql_connection} that counts the rows of each of two of its tables.
Give me a query on {sql_connection} for the 10 newest rows of a table that has a timestamp column.
What failed last night?
Give me a short overview of this workspace: its connections, its pipelines and its workflows.
